title: Harness registry
description: Curated list of benchmarkable harnesses. Baked into the toolkit image, so a caller can only choose among entries that exist at the release. Adding a harness is a pull request.

image.description: Adapter image: the harness at a pinned version plus a thin entrypoint that implements the adapter contract.

config_digest.description: Tree digest of the adapter's config/, its stock configuration, which the image holds at /hb/config (spec §6.4).

build_commit.description: The commit of this repository that .github/workflows/harness.yml built the image from (spec §6.4). Not part of the entry key.
